number.description: int The value to convert. Positive and negative values are handled.

base.description: int, optional Convert `number` to the `base` number system. The valid range is 2-36, the default value is 2.

padding.description: int, optional Number of zeros padded on the left. Default is 0 (no padding).

output.description: ------- str String representation of `number` in `base` system.
